title: Abɔde Kronkron no Sɔhwɛ
intro: Wɔde sɛnkyerɛnne bi kɔmaa ɔman bi a wɔayera. Wɔ wɔn asetra a ahotɔ wom no mu no, kɔkɔbɔ bi bae—a abɔde bi a ɔyɛ nwonwa a na ɔbɛyɛ wɔn gyidi ho sɔhwɛ a etwa to ka ho. Ná wɔn mmuae no bɛsɔ wɔn nkrabea agyirae daa. So wubetumi ahu onii a ɔde kɔkɔbɔ yi mae ne nea ɛtoo wɔn a wɔpowee no?
clues: Na yɛyɛ nkurɔfo a na abɔfo a wɔadi kan adi yɛn anim no akyerɛ yɛn kwan.
Abɔde a ne ho yɛ nwonwa puei fi bepɔw no so, sɛnkyerɛnne a efi yɛn Awurade hɔ maa ɔman yi.
Meka kyeree won se: 'Wei ye yoma abaa a eye Allah dea, enti monnyae no mma onnni Allah asaase so na monnka no mfa mpira.'
Nanso nkurɔfoɔ no twitwaa me yoma babaa no anan, na wɔbuu wɔn Awurade ahyɛdeɛ so.
Meyɛ ɔbɔfo nko ara a ofi w’Awurade hɔ, a wɔsomaa me ne nokware no—Meyɛ nkɔmhyɛni ne akoa a wotumi de ho to no so.
Na nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no deɛ, yɛn Awurade de aprannaa bɔɔ wɔn, na wɔankeka wɔn ho wɔ wɔn afie mu.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
